notes.title: Romantic horror game Draculesti fully funded on Kickstarter, Steam demo out now
notes.notes:
Vampires have never been hotter. I guess that's not true, considering they don't age and therefore have always looked this hot (or not, depending on your preferences), but you get what I mean. Upcoming romantic horror game Drăculești has been fully funded on Kickstarter, and it turns those vampire-loving dials up to 11. Self-published by developer Fine Feathered Fiends, the visual novel amps up the queer undertones of Bram Stoker's iconic epistolary tale for a steamy and sordid fantasy affair.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Drăculești - Now On Kickstarter (+ Demo Audio Update)
notes.notes: [p]Welcome back to Castle Dracula.[/p][p][/p][p]It's been a month since our Next Fest update, and we've used that time to improve some of the rougher scenes in Dracula and the Ghost's extended story segments. In particular, the audio for the General's appearances and the audio for the piano scene have been given a major overhaul. It's crucial that a musical talent like our Ghost be provided the best tools, and his old piano simply wasn't up to snuff! Perhaps it was all the bones Dracula left in it. How impolite.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to our audio update, we are excited to announce our [b]Drăculești Kickstarter campaign[/b], which is [b]live until August 9th[/b]![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qwpmRATtlzM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This campaign will cover finishing costs for the game, as well as the cost of partial voice acting. We have announced the first two actors in our exciting cast - [b]Ray Chase as Dracula [/b]and [b]Erika Ishii as Cez [/b]- and there are plenty more to come over the following weeks.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1712125696/draculesti" style="button" buttoncolor="#911e37"]Back Us On Kickstarter[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Our campaign page is over here, with plenty of tantalising rewards for backers. We hope you'll support us so we can finish the game to the best possible quality! And, if you're unable to back the campaign for whatever reason, sharing it widely is valuable to us too. Tell all the gays, Goths, and gay Goths you know about Drăculești![/p][p][/p][p]We'll likely have a few further QOL updates over the following weeks. In the meantime, we're sure the Ghost will play some lovely waiting music for you, now he's operating at the height of his power.[/p][p][/p][p]Eternally yours,[/p][p]The Fiends[/p]

notes.title: AdventureX 2024 - Livestream
notes.notes:
Drăculești is an official selection for AdventureX 2024! 

We're thrilled and honoured to be recognised by AdventureX. For the event, we're hosting a developer livestream, where our artist and writer will be running through 👻 the Ghost's route 👻 of the demo.

Keep an eye out for it 👁️

notes.title: Happy Steam Scream Fest 3!
notes.notes:
Happy Steam Scream Fest 3!

To celebrate the spooky season, we've recently updated our demo with bug fixes and new art assets in several key sequences.

[list]
[*]NVL mode displays transitions correctly
[*]'Hunt' sequence features new artwork
[*]'Breakfast' sequence features new artwork
[*]UI has been adjusted to provide clearer distinction between narration and spoken dialogue
[*]Twitch integration tutorialisation has been reworded, and UI has been adjusted
[*]Tutorial has been reworded for clarity
[*]Minor adjustments for many backgrounds, overlays, and other art assets
[/list]
These improvements are sure to make your stay in Castle Dracula more comfortable! We encourage you to pay it a visit this Halloween.

notes.title: Drăculești - Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
The Drăculești demo is now available for PC!

This demo introduces all four love interests, and runs approximately 40-60 minutes per playthrough.

[i](Please note that Jonny is a New Game+ option, and only available after your first playthrough)[/i]

Enjoy your stay in the castle, and if you have a pleasant trip, please wishlist and recommend it to others!

Now... best head on in. Dracula doesn't like to be kept waiting.

notes.title: The Storyteller's Festival 2024
notes.notes:
Happy Storyteller's Festival 2024!

As part of the festival, we'll be streaming a preview of our upcoming demo, showcasing the first part of one of the character routes. Stop by the castle, meet the residents, and enjoy their company over a glass of... red.
